competition_score_direction_by_format.name: competition_score_direction_by_format
competition_score_direction_by_format.value:
case "competition"."format"::text
        when 'participation' then "competition"."score_direction"::text = 'none'
        when 'best-score' then "competition"."score_direction"::text in ('higher', 'lower')
        else true
        end

competition_participation_columns.name: competition_participation_columns
competition_participation_columns.value:
case when "competition"."format"::text = 'participation'
        then case when "competition"."scoring" = 'individual'
          then "competition"."participation_points" is not null
            and "competition"."placement_points" is null
          else "competition"."placement_points" is not null
            and "competition"."participation_points" is null
          end
        else "competition"."participation_points" is null
          and not "competition"."self_check_in"
        end

finale_slide_custom_columns.name: finale_slide_custom_columns
finale_slide_custom_columns.value: ("finale_slide"."kind"::text = 'custom') = ("finale_slide"."heading" is not null) and ("finale_slide"."kind"::text = 'custom' or ("finale_slide"."body" is null and "finale_slide"."background_color" is null))

points_entry_reason_without_competition.name: points_entry_reason_without_competition
points_entry_reason_without_competition.value: "points_entry"."competition_id" is not null or "points_entry"."note" is not null
